_comment: The entry to add to englishm/moq-interop-runner's implementations.json.
Not submitted: that means opening a PR against someone else's repository.
Validate with their implementations.schema.json before sending.
Both images are published by .github/workflows/docker.yml on every push
to main, and built locally by interop/moq-runner/build_image.sh. They
pass 7/7 against each other over a compose-style network.

quic-zig.name: quic-zig
quic-zig.notes: QUIC, HTTP/3, WebTransport and MoQ from scratch in Zig. The relay is WebTransport; the client speaks both transports and selects its draft with --draft.
